title: Lens Material Re-Billing on Late Northgate Optical Prescription-Change Remakes
content:
Where a Northgate Optical eyewear job carries a material upgrade charge on its original order, the late prescription-change remake charge re-bills part or all of it, according to the job's lens material.

**Clause.** Where the job's lens material is a 1.60, 1.67 or 1.74 high index material and a material upgrade charge stands on the original job, net of credits against it, the late prescription-change remake charge also re-bills that whole net material upgrade charge; where the material is polycarbonate or Trivex and such a charge stands, it re-bills half of that net material upgrade charge (50 percent). Where the material is standard plastic, or no net material upgrade charge stands, nothing is re-billed.

**The net material upgrade charge.** The material upgrade charge of the original job (remake number 0), less every credit posted against material upgrade charges of the job — a Plus-discounted charge counts at the amount posted, and a cancellation or other refund already credited against it reduces it. The charge "stands" when that net amount is above zero.

## Re-billed amount by material

| Lens material on the job | Net material upgrade charge above zero | Re-billed |
|---|---|---|
| 1.60, 1.67 or 1.74 high index | yes | the whole net material upgrade charge |
| polycarbonate or Trivex | yes | half of the net material upgrade charge |
| any material | no (none posted, or fully credited) | nothing |
| standard plastic | — | nothing |

## Examples (hypothetical jobs)

- Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses in 1.67 high index, material upgrade charge 70.00, no credits against it: 70.00 is re-billed.
- Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses in polycarbonate, material upgrade charge 25.50 (after a Plus discount), no credits: 12.75 is re-billed.
- Northgate Single Vision Lenses in Trivex, material upgrade charge 40.00 with a 40.00 credit against it: the net is 0.00, so nothing is re-billed.
